mcqs.prompt: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
mcqs.rationale: The search space halves each step, so it takes about log2(n) steps.
mcqs.hint: How many times can you halve n?

mcqs.question: Which data structure gives O(1) average-time lookups by key?
mcqs.explanation: Hash tables map keys to buckets directly; the others need O(n) or O(log n) searches.
